description: This file contains definitions of test classes for fault injection in distributed RPC backend contexts within PyTorch, including configuration options and agent classes used for testing fault scenarios.

classes.name: FaultyTensorPipeRpcBackendOptions
classes.description: A subclass of _TensorPipeRpcBackendOptionsBase that introduces additional parameters for simulating faults during RPC communication, such as messages to fail or delay and number of failed sends.

classes.name: FaultyTensorPipeAgent
classes.description: A subclass of TensorPipeAgent that utilizes FaultyTensorPipeRpcBackendOptions to facilitate fault-injected testing scenarios.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructors for FaultyTensorPipeRpcBackendOptions and FaultyTensorPipeAgent, initializing configuration parameters related to fault injection and setting up distributed RPC agents for testing.
